title: Art By Committee: ‘Looming Up’ Results
content: On Wednesdays we've been playing a group sketch game called "Art By Committee," where I give you an an actual excerpt taken out of context from a science fiction manuscript and you come up with a sketch to illustrate it.Here are this week’s results, followed by the sketch that originally appeared in my book AND a new quote for next week. Great job, everyone!Jason PeckTed WilsonDave HarshbergerArthur KeeganGuillame DecauxRoberta BairdMarcus BlättermannJoshua HendryMark HengJen ZellerTidah AdipatSusan AdsettGally MathiasAnd the CommitteeNext week’s quote: “…protested. He too was tinted orange with anticipation.”
